words.sense: A sustained, organized treatment or discussion of ideas in speech or writing.
misconceptions: Assumes all communication is two-way exchange.
Treats any conversation, however brief, as developed discourse.

words.sense: A direct two-way exchange in which participants respond to each other.
misconceptions: Assumes all communication is two-way exchange.
Treats any conversation, however brief, as developed discourse.

semantic_axes.description: Discourse emphasizes sustained development of ideas, while dialogue emphasizes reciprocal exchange between participants.
